title: a cron prompt reads a log file that nothing writes any more
evidence: 2 cron prompt log reference(s) point at a file nothing writes, so the step that reads it cannot tell 'no errors' from 'no signal': tc-weekly-persona-review (8d3ac21799d5) reads log/growth_harness.log -- unwritten for 30.6d; tc-overnight-watchdog (31c2d0bc8261) reads log/growth_harness.log -- unwritten for 30.6d -- replace the path with the repo-owned command (`python3 bin/tc_ops.py log-health` prints every live log's age and recent error lines, so it cannot rot when a writer moves)

notes.note: 2026-09-20 15:5xZ ops-triage: filed by the new check (this run). Measured: log/growth_harness.log mtime 2026-08-20 (30.6d) while tc-overnight-watchdog and tc-weekly-persona-review both still instruct runs to tail it. In-repo half DONE and verified: check_cron_prompt_log_paths + a repo-owned command, python3 bin/tc_ops.py log-health, which prints each live log age and error lines and names the deprecated path (live: scheduled_posting 0.6h/0 errors, development 0.0h/0, comfyui_harness 9.5h/0, growth_harness DEPRECATED 30.6d). Remaining half is one line in jobs.json (outside this repo): replace "tail -40 log/growth_harness.log" with "python3 bin/tc_ops.py log-health" in both prompts.
